tool.name: Ping Identity for AI
tool.description: Runtime identity for AI agents: Agent IAM Core, an Agent Gateway enforcing fine-grained authorization, and agent detection.
strengths: Detects external agents via bot signals
tool.practitionerNote: Worth evaluating when agents must be authorised per request at a gateway; builds on PingOne, so value is highest for existing Ping customers.

dataResidency.detail: Data residency for Identity for AI is not stated in the launch release or docs landing page.

deployment.detail: Built on the PingOne cloud platform; GA globally by 2026-03-31.

auditLogging.detail: Agent Gateway centralizes monitoring and audit of agent interactions.

soc2.detail: Ping trust center states SOC 2 Type 2; product scope not specified.

iso27001.detail: Ping trust center states ISO 27001 (plus 27018); product scope not specified.

iso42001.detail: ISO/IEC 42001 is not mentioned on the Ping trust center.

euAiAct.detail: Identity and access-control tooling for agents, not itself an AI system placed on the market; AI Act obligations rest with the provider/deployer of the governed agents.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary SaaS; no OSS path, identity layer creates platform lock-in.
